method: Source report-date header inventory; legacy N5 accepts Excel datetime or unambiguous year-first Gregorian text only, retaining S9 raw; DDR uses F11/H11/J11; volatile date formulas are retained with cached values but excluded from date comparisons. Non-increasing comparisons are between adjacent recognized status worksheets in numeric-prefix order with both dates parseable. Date readings and prefix ordering are not independently verified, and matching/equal dates are not necessarily errors. No elapsed campaign durations inferred.
